title: Default demo operation endpoints retain low-privilege submitted users in a process-lifetime static map
driver: number of requests or imported rows; each add gets a new Integer key from users.size()+1
dimension: heap object count and key cardinality
retention: static map for process lifetime; only manual /demo/operate/clean clears it
bound: no size cap, TTL, per-user quota, or default permission annotation; Shiro login required
default_deployment: application.yml has demoEnabled=true; README/SQL initialize default users
impact_hypothesis: low-privilege repeated POSTs can grow heap and slow list/export operations until JVM memory pressure or service degradation
scope_notes: non-disk; not admin-only; default demo feature; dynamic OOM not verified
